Pin commit; inspect local changes; inventory sources, roots, authorities, references, and all generators/writers.

### Gate to proceed

items.title: DECISION D1 - Module authority location
items.body:
**Module authority location**

### Recommended default
One `<existing-module-root>/manifest.json` per module; retain the currently approved filename if different.

### Why it matters
Avoid introducing a second module authority or coupling this work to folder migration.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D2 - Meaning of single authority
items.body:
**Meaning of single authority**

### Recommended default
Module JSON owns module-specific specs; shared contracts and global process definitions retain their own authorities.

### Why it matters
Prevent conflicting copies of shared facts inside 34 files.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D3 - Schema evolution
items.body:
**Schema evolution**

### Recommended default
Publish a new major schema version for breaking changes; keep the supplied v1 schema immutable.

### Why it matters
Changing process cardinality and provenance requires an explicit migration.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D4 - Decision authority
items.body:
**Decision authority**

### Recommended default
Repository owner, or explicitly delegated reviewer, approves semantic resolutions; automation may propose.

### Why it matters
A confidence score or historical document label is not approval.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D5 - Automation boundary
items.body:
**Automation boundary**

### Recommended default
Pilot requires review of every change; later permit only expressly approved low-risk rules.

### Why it matters
Blank fields can still receive wrong information.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D6 - Header and archive policy
items.body:
**Header and archive policy**

### Recommended default
Preserve original bytes; annotate an archived prose copy; use a standard sidecar and notice for every format.

### Why it matters
Meet the notice requirement without corrupting JSON, CSV, PDFs, or evidence.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.

items.title: DECISION D7 - Disposition of the competing manifest bundle
items.body:
**Disposition of the competing manifest bundle**

### Recommended default
Decide the fate of EAFIX_auth_docs/manifests/eafix_module_manifests_bundle.vNext.schema_valid.json: regenerate-from-roots, or archive. VERIFIED 2026-09-22: it holds all 34 manifests in the identical v1 shape and already disagrees with the module roots on 28 of 34 (file_ownership, reconciliation_status, last_updated_utc, notes).

### Why it matters
A live second authority can silently reverse the P6 cutover. Not in the original Section 2 list; added from baseline verification.

### Close criteria
- [ ] Owner decision recorded in the consolidation policy
- [ ] Who may approve exceptions is named

---
Blocks P1. Execution must not begin while this is open.
